# utf8proc provenance

Wio vendors utf8proc 2.11.3 from the upstream
`JuliaStrings/utf8proc` release tag `v2.11.3`. The runtime compiles it as a
static C object so normalization behavior and Unicode data remain identical on
Windows, Linux, and macOS.

Upstream: https://github.com/JuliaStrings/utf8proc/tree/v2.11.3

The upstream MIT/expat and Unicode data license is preserved in `LICENSE.md`.

- `utf8proc.h`: `A4E498B7392C383CF3B22E662DA21E0B48F1264806235D87B5D8BD166232F658`
